context: Extend scripts/generate-browser-fixtures.mjs with an opt-in larger corpus. Decide size from the real condition being tested - enough rows to exceed several pages and to reproduce the 17,441px Compare document - and decide whether it runs per-PR or nightly based on generation cost. Keep the default fixture unchanged so existing specs keep their timings.
description:
The browser fixture corpus is 11 results. No paging, virtualisation or scale claim in this sequence can be verified against it. Earlier plan revisions promised document-height proof at 1440px and 390px without a fixture capable of producing the condition.

This item is entry criteria for rx-ux-17 and rx-ux-19.

anti_patterns.dont: bump the read-model version to make fixture generation easier
anti_patterns.why: the pin is guarded and a bump has pipeline and browser consequences

anti_patterns.instead: add an opt-in larger fixture behind a flag or env var
anti_patterns.why: existing specs pin ids and timings against the 11-result set

anti_patterns.dont: cite e2e/capability/range-read-budget.spec.ts as scale or cold-load evidence
anti_patterns.instead: assert document height and rendered row count at 1440px and 390px
anti_patterns.why: that spec is test.skip'ed at range-read-budget.spec.ts:56 and does not run

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight
anti_patterns.why: AGENTS.md makes the primary clone read-only for agents

preserves.behavior: Read-model version 7 pin in _project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/contract.py and results-explorer/src/db.ts (EXPECTED_READ_MODEL_VERSION), guarded by db-remediation-pin.test.ts.
The existing 11-result default fixture and every spec that depends on its ids (e2e/support/fixture-ids.json)

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run test:e2e:fixtures && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:chromium
verifications.description: Default fixture unchanged and existing specs pass
verifications.expected: fixtures verified; chromium suite green with unchanged ids

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npx playwright test --project=chromium --grep 'large corpus'
verifications.description: Larger fixture reproduces the unbounded-document condition
verifications.expected: Compare document height exceeds several viewports with the large fixture

work_units.evidence: Selected 280 opt-in additions (291 total): exceeds the 200-row paging boundary and produces Compare documents above 17,441px at 1440x900 and 390x844.
work_units.summary: Decide corpus size from the conditions to be tested

work_units.evidence: E2E_FIXTURE_PROFILE=large generates deterministic version-7 bundles; E2E_FIXTURE_OUTPUT_ROOT isolates them from the default corpus and fixture role IDs.
Measured large generation 7.00s, determinism verification 7.59s, two-viewport browser proof 10.04s; retained as a per-PR Chromium case.
work_units.summary: Measure generation cost and decide per-PR vs nightly

work_units.evidence: Default generator still produces 11 results and identical fixture role IDs; full Chromium gate passed 111 regular tests plus large case, 12 skipped, 9 failure tests, and performance smoke.
work_units.summary: Verify default fixture and existing specs unaffected
